column1: # The .docx corpus: name, source, SHA-256 and what the reader is expected to do.
# Fetched by `cargo xtask corpus --docx`; the documents themselves stay out of the repository.
# The expectation is "ok" (read → write → read keeps everything) or "refused: <reason>".

column4: refused: 5,000 nested tables (15,005 XML levels) — the reader's nesting limit refuses it, as it must
refused: the file is truncated, so it is not a valid package
